limits: One administrator, one owned configuration and zero Agents; no restricted principal, group/composite/chain-wide or untrusted approval claim.
Manual start is explicitly NOT approval; timeout explicitly one minute, not an absent-default observation.
Timeout reads as finished/FAILURE/failedToStart without canceledInfo; approval status timedOut. Do not replace literal projection with a generic cancelled state from help.
Unknown-user rule reports configurationValid=true and a deleted-user sentinel, then failed-to-start; this is not a malformed-rule configurationValid=false oracle.
Repeat approval on the already approved Build returns400. Unknown-user approval request returns200 but remains waitingForApproval; no blanket repeat or success-implies-approved inference.
Prior two acquisitions failed local guessed observation assertions, with project/gates cleaned. Their immutable diagnostics are not substituted for this completed literal acquisition.
Reference and replay controls are not Vivarium product GREEN or additional known product cases.
